conversation.message: Yes, I’m checking the final experiments and making sure the results and comparisons are consistent.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. A careful final check should help before you prepare the ICML submission.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. Once the experiment checks are done, I’ll focus on polishing the paper for ICML.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier NeurIPS submission plan; retain my current ICML plan and the rest of the project information.
